programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary. The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy. The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack. Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports. One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel. The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the New York City Police Department is fighting a losing battle in the war on drugs. Distributors and drug gangs in New York are making millions, and they will do anything to protect their profits. After two law enforcement officers are targeted, hundreds of police officers and FBI agents devise a bold plan to crackdown on the drug gangs and shut down their deadly business.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1999, Police investigate two brutal murders in two small towns located hundreds of miles apart. The crimes seem random and unrelated, until investigators discover a terrifying link. Local police and the FBI must untangle a web of liesto stop a dangerous gang that will kill a man for his Identity.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot. The gunman was desperate to stay free, a threat to anyone in his way. The FBI and U.S. marshals teamed up to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Boston, FBI agents and local police tracked a gang of robbers who specialized in armored car takedowns. Their MO was familiar -- the gang used precise timing to steal millions in cash and burned their getaway cars to destroy evidence. As the robberies grew more violent, agents launched a complex sting: To trap a deadly ring of thieves and shut down their dangerous operation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the winter of 2001, two well-loved and respected college professors are found murdered in their home. Nothing about the case makes sense. No items are missing from the home and the couple had no known enemies. Local police and FBI agents form a task force to find a pair of homegrown killers and a motive for the brutal crime they committed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Georgia, a series of bizarre shootings terrorizes the town of East Point. Two people are killed, and two are critically wounded. At first the shootings seem targeted, then they seem random. As the body count climbs, the killer taunts law enforcement with mysterious notes. Agents believe the shooter will continue until he is deador behind bars.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 90s, a gang based in the U.S. Virgin Islands began smuggling thousands of kilos of cocaine into mainland America. Police and federal agents target the gang, but its leader remains a mystery. In an investigation spanning from Georgia to South America, local police, the DEA, U.S. Customs and the FBI work together to take down this dangerous drug gang.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
programme.desc: El primero de octubre de 1993, un extraño secuestró a Polly Klaas de doce años durante una piyamada en su casa. El FBI de inmediato entró en el caso. Los agentes reunieron fibras de su habitación y descubrieron, a través del uso de fuentes de luz láser, la huella de una palma en la cama de Polly, previamente invisible al ojo humano. Después de una extensa investigación de dos meses, el FBI arrestó a Richard Allen Davis. La impresión de la palma y las fibras coincidieron y Davis fue condenado por secuestro y asesinato.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway. Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home. Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI (Doblado)
programme.desc: El 21 de junio de 1964, tres defensores de los derechos civiles, uno blanco y uno negro, desaparecieron de Mississippi mientras cruzaban el condado de Neshoba. Una investigación del FBI a gran escala llevó a la recuperación de los cuerpos de los hombres asesinados y la evidencia física fue recuperada y analizada. Los laboratorios del FBI confirmaron que todas excepto una de las balas usadas para asesinar a los hombres provenían de la misma arma. El FBI se ganó la confianza de un informante, cuya información condujo a la condena de siete miembros del Ku Klux Klan local.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Two couples found themselves on the same deserted island paradise. But only one couple left alive. Buck Walker and Stephanie Stearns arrived in Hawaii on the Sea Wind, which belonged to the missing couple, Mac and Muff Graham. Buck and Stephanie were arrested and served time for boat theft. But years later, bones were discovered on the deserted island and identified as the remains of Muff Graham.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On June 21, 1964, three civil rights workers, two white and one black disappeared in Mississippi while passing through Neshoba County. A massive FBI investigation led to the recovery of the bodies of the slain men and physical evidence was recovered and analyzed. The FBI labs confirmed that all but one of the bullets used to kill the men came from the same gun. The FBI gained the trust of an informant, whose information led to the conviction of seven local Ku Klux Klan members.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie

programme.desc: En britisk student faller for en amerikansk student, bare for å bli skilt fra ham når hun blir utvist fra USA etter å ha overskredet oppholdstillatelsen sin.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence
programme.desc: Annoyed by a club member's constant chatter, a man bets him he cannot remain silent for a year, living in a glass enclosure in the club basement.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Velkommen til en katolsk jenteskole i hjertet av Chicago, hjemstedet til USAs favorittdanseshow: Dance TV! Utvekslingsstudenten Janey Glenn er et nervevrak når hun blir introdusert for sine fnisende klassekamerater av den strenge søster Katherine.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: War Of The Wildcats
programme.desc: A confident oil baron and a determined cowboy are rivals for Oklahoma land and oil rights, and for the love of a pretty schoolteacher. The cowboy acts on behalf of the Indians, on whose land the oil is discovered.

programme.title: Øya I Himmelhavet
programme.desc: Filmen utspiller seg etter andre verdenskrig, og John Wayne spiller hovedrollen som Dooley, en tidligere militærpilot som flyr fraktfly og blir tvunget til å nødlande på en islagt innsjø fordi han går tom for drivstoff og flyet kommer ut av kurs.

programme.title: Fire never i Rio
programme.desc: De rike fetterne Antonio og Sebastiano Coimbra er to brasilianske mangemillionærer som lever i frykt for yrkesmordere. Derfor ansetter de to dobbeltgjengere, Greg Wonder som er en kriminelt belastet saxofonspiller, og stuntmannen Eliot Vance.

programme.title: Sammen tar vi prisen
programme.desc: Det blir action når det blir gjensyn med de actionkomikerne Terence Hill og Bud Spencer. Denne gangen spiller Hill en gjeldstynget gambler som finner et skattekart og sniker seg med en båt for å komme seg til en sydhavsøy der skatten skal være begravd.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Andromeda: Og ditt hjerte vil fly bort
programme.desc: Når en forlengst mistet kjærlighet kommer tilbake, forsvinner Tyr fra skipet for å beskytte henne mot en snikmorder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ukontrable mannen
programme.desc: Sett i et alternativt univers der Dylan døde og Gaheris Rhade prøver å reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som angrep Andromeda under den første undertegningen av Commonwealth-charteret, vender tilbake til mer kaos.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Dark Backward
programme.desc: Trance går gjennom noen forskjellige scenarier og prøver å finne en der mannskapet hennes ikke dør.

programme.title: Mutant X: No Exit
programme.desc: En mutant som har muligheten til å feste med hvilken som helst datamaskin med tankene sine, som er lammet etter et møte med teamet, tar over Sanctuarys datamaskiner.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er løst
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr blir overtatt av energien fra en dimensjonal tunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem før de ødelegger skipet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Skårene i Rimni
programme.desc: Dylan er innrammet for drap og må rydde navnet sitt mens han finner bitene i en vase som sies å gi eieren kosmos 'velsignelser.'

programme.title: Andromeda: Mad to Be Saved
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en gruppe flyktninger, bare for å oppdage at de har vært utsatt for regjeringseksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekas onkel løper for kontoret i New Commonwealth, men et attentat får mannskapet til å opptre som hans sikkerhet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensomme og jevne sanden
programme.desc: Når Andromeda blir angrepet av rompirater, blir de reddet av et langt mistet romskip fra jorden.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 8
programme.desc: This episode includes: Drug Family Fugitives & UD, Ghost Writer, Is Borton Back?, Pts. 1 & 2 and UD: Viet Pilot's Daughter.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 9
programme.desc: This episode includes: Gurdon Light, A Prisoner Named Stuart & UD, UD: Lifesaving Sister and Themla & Louise Bandits & UD.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 10
programme.desc: This episode includes: Cyril Wecht, Psychic Family Roots, Search for Kristi and Baby Brother Lost & UD.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 11
programme.desc: This episode includes: San Marino Bones & UD, Phantom Sub, Police Captain's Death, UD: Baby Girl X and School Bus Family & UD.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Shawn Grate
programme.desc: Shawn was a good looking boy, and he learnt that he could turn on a smile and get what he wanted. He was popular with women but often in trouble for abusing them. He was sent to prison at 22 for choking his pregnant girlfriend.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Donna Perry
programme.desc: In Spokane three prostitutes were violently killed. Evidence suggested they'd been approached by a man wanting sex who had then used great strength to subdue and kill them. They had the suspects DNA, but detectives had no idea who the killer was.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Malcolm Webster
programme.desc: Nurse Malcolm Webster was convicted for the murder of his first wife, Claire Morris. For 17 years it was believed to be an accident; until he staged another 'road accident' in New Zealand, involving his second wife, Felicity Drumm.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Vickie Dawn Jackson
programme.desc: Vickie Dawn Jackson was described as sweet and 'gone to fat' by locals in her small Texas town. Why did Vickie kill off the friends and relatives of those whom she knew in Nocona, Texas?

programme.title: On the Case: Golden Promises Broken
programme.desc: High school sweethearts disappear during a picnic and investigators spend years chasing false leads.

programme.title: On the Case: Nine Days of Terror
programme.desc: When a young college student disappears out of a mall parking lot, police find themselves in a race against time to find her before it is too late.

programme.title: On the Case: Lying in Wait
programme.desc: A young mother goes out for a jog and runs into her killer. Does her teenage daughter hold the clue to solve the case?

programme.title: On the Case: Haunting Memories
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old college student Kim Montelaro goes missing from a mall parking lot, then her lifeless body is found in a ravine five miles from the mall; investigators piece together the timeline of Montelaro's last moments alive and crack the case.

programme.title: On the Case: A Long Journey To Justice
programme.desc: When a young college student is found murdered on the side of road, it is the start of a tormenting 26 year journey to justice for her family.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Who Killed the Beauty Queen?
programme.desc: In 2005, a college student and aspiring beauty queen Nona Dirksmeyer was found murdered inside her apartment. Police believed Nona's boyfriend flew into a murderous rage when he discovered a condom wrapper on her kitchen counter.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Peace, Love and Murder
programme.desc: A report on the murder of housewife Toni Heartsong, killed in her Jupiter, Florida home on in 2000. Her husband was initially eliminated as a possible suspect, but in 2006, new DNA technology revealed the presence of his blood under Toni's thumbnail.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Vegas Heat
programme.desc: A report on the 2005 discovery of the charred corpse of a young woman, found in a burned-out car on a Las Vegas desert road. The car was registered to Kelly Ryan, a fitness champion who is married to Craig Titus, a Mr. Olympia competitor.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Peter Chadwick: Caught
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A fishy moped license plate foils a potential burglary, a violent stalker is arrested trying to beat down a door, and an arson suspect is caught in the nude.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Officers split up to interrogate two men suspected of stealing a pick-up truck, a motorist tries to ditch a bag of meth, and police discover a bunch of syringes in a vehicle.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A Kansas man pulls a gun on his brother, a woman reports her ex violating a court order to stay away from her, and officers have a heart-to-heart with a struggling addict.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Officers save a suspect's life after arresting him, a man assaults his wife after she uncovers his internet history, and a pregnant woman fears prosecuting her abuser.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A suspect tries to bargain with officers from a rooftop, a nightclub manager confronts the employee who stole his cash, and a talkative man insists he meant to get arrested.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Watching football turns a couple against each other, a cop gets fed up with a repeat shoplifter, and a man tries to swallow a bag of marijuana before officers find it.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Fort Bend, Texas deputies arrest a man for possession of a crack pipe, and Michigan and Washington police both respond to domestic violence situations.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: Police help a man evacuate a house fire, a high-speed chase yields only minor infractions, and an officer interrogates a parolee with meth in his car.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murderous Lovers - Anne Bardot
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of 4 years old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair
programme.desc: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 506
programme.desc: 26. januar 2001 ble Benjamin Hermansen knivstukket til døde som følge av sin hudfarge. Drapet fikk hele landet til å delta i antirasistiske markeringer og protester.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 403
programme.desc: Marit Ødegaard jobber på en veikro ikke langt fra svenskegrensen. En oktoberdag i 2000 dukker hun ikke opp på jobb. Kort tid etter blir Marit funnet drept i hjemmet sitt

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker
programme.desc: En familie som rammes av en husbrann klarer å unnslippe flammene, men alt de eier har blitt til aske. Det som først ser ut til å være en ulykke, viser seg å være mye mer komplisert.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker
programme.desc: En tidlig februarmorgen i Stockholm melder en mann sin kone, Sacha, savnet. Etter hvert som politiet graver i parets fortid, oppdager de et turbulent forhold under den tilsynelatende ryddige overflaten.

programme.title: Svenske krimsaker
programme.desc: Da 32 år gamle Memo plutselig forsvinner, tar vennene hans saken i egne hender og begynner å lete desperat etter ham. Bekymringen forvandles til frykt når letingen fører til urovekkende oppdagelser.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Dummy

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
programme.desc: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.

programme.desc: A little person challenges an officer; police settle a violent fight between two combatants from different generations; a passionate kiss is the cause of a hit-and-run accident; father and stepson have a fight.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

programme.title: The Return Of The Living Dead
programme.desc: On his first day at a medical supply warehouse, Freddy (Thom Mathews) unwittingly releases toxic gas from a secret U.S. military canister. The gas reanimates an army of corpses, who arise from their graves with a ravenous hunger...for human brains!

programme.title: Pumpkinhead
programme.desc: In this atmospheric horror classic directed by special effect legend Stan Winston, Ed Harley (Lance Henriksen) seeks the help of a witch to invoke the demon "Pumpkinhead" in order to exact revenge on the teenagers who inadvertently killed his son.

programme.title: The Horror Show
programme.desc: A maniacal murderer (Brion James) returns from the depths of hell to seek revenge on the cop who captured him in this supernatural horror-fest!

programme.title: To All A Good Night
programme.desc: The Calvin Finishing School for Girls is closed for Christmas vacation. However, Mrs. Jensen (the housemother), five teenage girls and their mischievous male companions are all that remain at the school...or are they?

programme.title: Tentacles
programme.desc: It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

programme.title: The Comedy Of Terrors
programme.desc: Facing a mound of debt, an devious undertaker and his reluctant assistant devise a wickedly funny plan to make death pay...by creating customers!

programme.title: Twice Told Tales
programme.desc: Virtuoso of horror Vincent Price ("Tales of Terror") dials up the depravity in this spellbinding trilogy of Nathaniel Hawthorne's chilling classics!

programme.title: Diary Of A Madman
programme.desc: The legendary Vincent Price turns in another classic performance in this intelligent and grim thriller about a magistrate who just might be possessed.

programme.title: The Oblong Box
programme.desc: Vincent Price buries his disfigured brother alive, but the body is dug up by a doctor (Christopher Lee). Still alive, the brother seeks his revenge.

programme.title: Scream And Scream Again
programme.desc: A scientist commits a series of murders in his quest to create a race of super humans. Vincent Price, Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing star.

programme.title: Madhouse (1974)
programme.desc: When a washed-up horror actor (Vincent Price) agrees to do a TV-series, the cast begin dying in ways similar to the deaths in the actor's old movies.

programme.title: Dr. Phibes Rises Again!
programme.desc: The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!

programme.title: Theater Of Blood
programme.desc: Vincent Price is a crazed Shakespearean actor who adds murder to his repertoire when he takes gruesome revenge on the critics who slighted him.

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: Lifeforce
programme.desc: Steve Railsback stars in this frightening journey into the unknown as a mission to investigate Halley's Comet discovers an alien craft whose seductive leader begins a terrifying campaign to drain the lifeforce of everyone she encounters!

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: The Curse
programme.desc: When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change...hideously!

programme.title: Die, Monster, Die!
programme.desc: An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

programme.title: The Dunwich Horror
programme.desc: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

programme.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
programme.desc: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

programme.title: Murders In The Rue Morgue
programme.desc: In Paris, a theatrical company with a specialty in Grand Guignol undertakes their most gruesome production yet! And the blood will flow!

programme.title: Whoever Slew Auntie Roo?
programme.desc: Shelley Winters puts the Grande in Grande Dame Guignol in director Curtis Harrington's atmospheric, suspenseful and surprisingly moving cult chiller.

programme.title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
programme.desc: In this terrifying sequel, the spirits of the dead are still hell-bent on luring the Freeling's daughter to the other side, where lies only evil!

programme.title: Poltergeist III
programme.desc: Nancy Allen, Tom Skerritt, Zelda Rubenstein and Heather O'Rourke star in this suspense-filled conclusion to the terrifying "Poltergeist" trilogy.

programme.title: Burnt Offerings
programme.desc: Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.

programme.title: The Believers
programme.desc: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

programme.title: The Book of Love
programme.desc: Henry (Jason Sudeikis) is a widowed architect who strikes up a friendship with Millie (Maisie Williams), an independent but troubled teen. Hoping to find her long-lost father, Millie asks Henry to build her a raft that can sail across the ocean. After agreeing to do so, the unlikely duo embark on an incredible adventure that deepens their bond and lifts their spirits.

programme.title: One Step Forward, Two Steps Back
programme.desc: A radiation leak sparks crisis.

programme.title: Two by Two
programme.desc: The crew must devise a plan after identifying a planet rich in much-needed fuel.

programme.title: The Librarian: Curse of the Judas Chalice
programme.desc: Unlikely adventurer Flynn Carsen sets out to protect a precious chalice from vampire Prince Vlad Dracul.

programme.title: And the Rise of Chaos
programme.desc: The Egyptian God of Chaos inhabits a human, and tries to release pure evil into the world; the librarians must decipher clues in a science museum.

programme.title: And the Fangs of Death
programme.desc: Flynn leads the others on a rescue mission, which leads them into a subterranean trap filled with ancient Egyptian werewolves.

programme.title: And the Reunion of Evil
programme.desc: A routine artifact retrieval becomes complicated when the artifact grafts itself to Cassandra; a blizzard forces Stone and Cassandra to take shelter at a mysterious hotel.

programme.title: And the Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
programme.desc: After seeing a vision of her own death at the hands of a supernatural assassin, Baird attempts to stop the deadly prophecy from coming true.

programme.title: And the Tears of a Clown
programme.desc: The librarians investigate a traveling carnival where they discover the sinister secret of a magician who has been corrupted by the use of real magic.

programme.title: And the Trial of the Triangle
programme.desc: In order to stop the spread of pure evil, the team must find the Eye of Ra and unravel the mystery of the Bermuda Triangle; Flynn must pass a series of tests.

programme.title: And the Curse of Cindy
programme.desc: Cindy Kroger suddenly becomes popular thanks to a magical love potion; the librarians must stop Cindy before she launches a love missile that would force the entire world to become her fan base.

programme.title: And the Eternal Question
programme.desc: The librarians are led to a holistic spa that is run by vampires when a rash of people spontaneously combust.

programme.title: And the Fatal Separation
programme.desc: The balance of the universe is put in jeopardy when the Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over by a ruthless collector of magical artifacts.

programme.title: And the Wrath of Chaos
programme.desc: The library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep; Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins must put aside their differences to save the library, the world and themselves.

programme.desc: The library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep; Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins must put aside their differences to save the library, the world and themselves.

programme.title: The Nigerian Job
programme.desc: After recovering stolen airplane designs, Nate's team must figure out how to return them to the rightful owner.

programme.title: The Homecoming Job
programme.desc: In order to help a wounded reservist, the team tries to expose the truth about a security firm.

programme.title: The Wedding Job
programme.desc: The team poses as wedding planners to get close to a Mafia boss and must pull off a wedding while pulling off the heist.

programme.title: The Snow Job
programme.desc: The team goes after a construction company that foreclosed on a National Guardsman's home; Nate puts the team in jeopardy with his drinking.

programme.title: The Mile High Job
programme.desc: All the evidence the team seeks to expose a cover-up is on a plane heading to the Cayman Islands; airborne, the team uncovers a more sinister situation.

programme.title: The Two Horse Job
programme.desc: The team travels to Kentucky to help a horse trainer who lost everything when the racehorses he trains were killed in a fire.

programme.title: The Bank Shot Job
programme.desc: Nate, Sophie and the mark are taken hostage during a bank robbery; the team tries to help the two amateur and desperate robbers.

programme.title: The Miracle Job
programme.desc: Nate helps his old friend Father Paul stop the demolition of his church. His means however, a fake miracle, are a lot less holy than his ends.

programme.title: The Stork Job
programme.desc: The team goes after an adoption company that is scamming couples looking to adopt war orphans; the team hijacks the production of a horror movie.

programme.title: The Juror No. 6 Job
programme.desc: One of Parker's aliases is chosen for jury duty; the team tries to stop someone from buying a favorable verdict in the trial.

programme.title: The 12 Step Job
programme.desc: The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

programme.title: The First David Job
programme.desc: The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

programme.title: The Second David Job
programme.desc: Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

programme.title: The Beantown Bailout Job
programme.desc: Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

programme.title: The Tap-Out Job
programme.desc: The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

programme.title: The Order 23 Job
programme.desc: The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

programme.title: The Fairy Godparents Job
programme.desc: A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

programme.title: The Three Days of the Hunter Job
programme.desc: A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

programme.title: The Top Hat Job
programme.desc: The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

programme.title: The Two Live Crew Job
programme.desc: The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

programme.title: The Ice Man Job
programme.desc: Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

programme.title: The Lost Heir Job
programme.desc: The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

programme.title: Something About Harry
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission...a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Zig Zag
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Nest
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Final Appeal (Part 1)
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Family Values
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: A New Life
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: The Surrogate
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: The Vessel
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Replica
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Think Like A Dinosaur
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Alien Shop
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Worlds Within
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: In The Blood
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Flower Child
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Free Spirit
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another...and is after her.

programme.title: Mindreacher
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Time To Time
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Rule Of Law
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Lion's Den
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning...but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: The Tipping Point
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination

programme.title: Dark Child
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: The Human Factor
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right...

programme.title: Human Trials
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Sandkings (Parts One and Two)
programme.desc: Beau Bridges stars in this bone-chilling thriller. A ride of harrowing suspense, this taut film is packed with heart-stopping tension that faithfully fulfills the tradition of the ground-breaking series upon which it is based, the "Outer Limits."

programme.title: Valerie 23
programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.title: Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.title: The Second Soul
programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.title: White Light Fever
programme.desc: An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.title: Virtual Future
programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.title: Living Hell
programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.title: Corner Of The Eye
programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Under The Bed
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.title: Dark Matters
programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.title: The Conversion
programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Quality Of Mercy
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Caught In The Act
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.title: The New Breed
programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.title: The Message
programme.desc: Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.title: If These Walls Could Talk
programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Birthright
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Voice Of Reason
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: A Stitch In Time
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Unnatural Selection
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I Hear You Calling
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Beyond The Veil
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: Patsy
programme.desc: Even with key DNA evidence, a new witness jeopardizes the conviction of a man suspected of bludgeoning a woman into a coma.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green think a life insurance salesman's valuable information about his policies was a motive for his murder.

programme.title: Sundown
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green track a gigolo and con artist who is suspected of murder, but they run into problems when McCoy and Carmichael interview a victim's family.

programme.title: Loco Parentis
programme.desc: When a teenager is found murdered, Detectives Briscoe and Green suspect a school bully who displays an avid interest in martial-arts weapons.

programme.title: Collision
programme.desc: A mentally disturbed suspect refuses to take his antidepressant medicine, rendering him incapable of standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Mother's Milk
programme.desc: The parents of a missing child accuse each other of having the baby until a gruesome discovery is made.

programme.title: Panic
programme.desc: Briscoe and Green believe a possible love triangle was the motive behind the attempted assassination of a best-selling author.

programme.title: Entitled
programme.desc: The detectives continue searching for a shooter who may be responsible for several unsolved murders years earlier.

programme.title: Fools for Love
programme.desc: McCoy has trouble holding a case against a teenager's boyfriend suspected of killing two girls when she refuses to talk about his abuse.

programme.title: Trade This
programme.desc: The murder of a stockbroker points to organized crime when the prime suspect is killed by a hired hit man.

programme.title: Black, White and Blue
programme.desc: McCoy and Carmichael find two patrolmen partially responsible for the killing of a white teenager in Harlem.

programme.title: Mega
